entry.title: A Closet Full of Skills and Nothing to Wear: The More Skills You Install, the Less Often Your Agent Picks the Right One (MCP Tools Hold Up Better)

link.title: A Closet Full of Skills and Nothing to Wear: The More Skills You Install, the Less Often Your Agent Picks the Right One (MCP Tools Hold Up Better)

entry.content: The full post, with the data and code, is at galinaalperovich.github.io/closet-full-of-skills.
entry.summary: I installed up to 1,000 skills and ~800 MCP tools in Claude Code and Codex. The skill each request was written for went from being picked 78–100% of the time to 10–34%; single-step MCP tool selection fell much less, from 84–88% to 77–80%, and held steady from ~200 to ~800 tools.
